description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the percentage breakdown of three components for two different methods, labeled "Standard" and "Ours". The vertical axis contains these categorical labels, ordered from bottom to top, without an explicit axis title. There is no visible horizontal value axis with tick marks or labels; however, the data represents percentages that sum to 100% for each category, as indicated by the annotations within the bars. The bars are stacked horizontally, with each full bar divided into three color-coded segments. According to the partially visible legend at the bottom, the orange segment represents "Generated Response" and the green segment represents "Other", while the label for the blue segment is partially obscured, ending in "text". For the "Standard" category, the stacked bar consists of a blue segment annotated with 23.6%, an orange segment annotated with 51.1%, and a green segment annotated with 25.3%. For the "Ours" category, the stacked bar consists of a blue segment annotated with 60.6%, an orange segment annotated with 31.7%, and a green segment that is partially cut off at the right edge. The categories are not sorted by a specific numerical value, as both represent a full 100% stack, and the percentage values are explicitly annotated as text within their respective colored segments. The entire chart is presented at a tilted angle.
